en: Determinate being is determined; something has a quality and is in it not only determined but limited; its quality is its limit, and with this limit posited it remains at first affirmative, quiet determinate being.

But this negation develops in such a way that the opposition of its determinate being to the negation, as the limit immanent to it, is itself the being-in-self of the something, and this being-in-self is thus only becoming for it, and this makes up its finitude.
zh: 定在是被规定的；某物有一种质，并且在质中不仅是被规定的，而且是被限制的；它的质就是它的界限，具带着这一界限，它起初仍然是肯定的、安静的定在。
但这一否定展开得如此：以它为内在界限的定在与否定之间的对立，本身就是某物的自身内存在，而这一自身内存在对它来说因而只是一种生成；这就构成了它的有限性。

en: When we say of things that they are finite, it is understood that they not only have a determinateness, that their quality is not only reality and determinate being-in-itself, that they are not merely limited – in that way they still have determinate being outside their limit –, but rather that non-being makes up their nature, their being.

Finite things are, but their relation to themselves is that, as negative, they relate themselves to themselves, and precisely in this relation to themselves they drive themselves beyond themselves, beyond their being.
They are, but the truth of this being is their end.
The finite not only changes like something in general, but it perishes, and it is not merely possible that it perishes in such a way that it could be without perishing.
Rather, the being of finite things as such consists in having the seed of perishing as their being-in-self; the hour of their birth is the hour of their death.
zh: 当我们说事物是有限的时候，这意思是：它们不仅有一种规定性，它们的质不仅是实在性与自在的规定，它们并非仅仅是有限制的——这样它们在其界限之外还有定在——而毋宁说，非存在构成了它们的本性、它们的存在。
有限的事物是，但它们与自身的关系在于：它们作为否定者与自身相关，恰恰正是在这种与自身的关系中把自己驱赶到自身之外、驱赶到它们的存在之外。
它们是，但这一存在的真理就是它们的终结。
有限者不仅仅像某物一般那样变化，而且它会消逝；并且不仅仅是它有可能以那种能够存在而不消逝的方式消逝。
毋宁说，有限事物作为这样的存在，就在于把消逝的种子作为它们的自身内存在而具有；它们出生的时刻就是它们死亡的时刻。

en: The thought of the finitude of things carries this mourning along with it, because finitude is qualitative negation driven to its extreme, in the simplicity of such a determinateness it has left them no affirmative being as distinguished from their determination to perish.

Because of this qualitative simplicity of the negation, which has retreated to the abstract opposition of nothing and perishing against being, finitude is the most obstinate category of the understanding; negation in general, determinate constitution, limit, can hold their own against their other, determinate being; even abstract nothing is given up for itself as abstraction; but finitude is negation fixed as it is in itself and therefore stands in stark contrast to its affirmative.

The finite can indeed be put into flux in this way; it is itself this, to be determined to its end, but only to its end; – rather it is the refusal to bring itself affirmatively toward its affirmative, the infinite, to let itself be reconciled with it; it is thus posited as inseparably bound to its nothing, and every reconciliation with its other, the affirmative, is thereby cut off.
The determination of finite things is not other than their end.
The understanding persists in this mourning of finitude, in that it makes non-being the determination of things, at the same time making them imperishable and absolute.

Their transitoriness could only perish in their other, the affirmative; then their finitude would separate itself from them; but it is their unalterable quality, that is, one which does not pass over into their other, that is, into their affirmative; thus it is eternal.
zh: 对事物有限性的思想随身带来这种哀痛，因为有限性是被推至极点的质上的否定，在这种规定性的单纯中，它已不再给它们留下一个与其走向消逝的规定相区分的肯定的存在。
由于否定在质上的这种单纯——它已退回为无与消逝反对存在的抽象对立——有限性是知性最顽固的范畴；否定一般、性质、界限都能与它们的他者、即定在相安；甚至抽象的无也被就其自身作为抽象而弃置；但有限性则是被固定为自在的否定，因此与它的肯定者截然对立。
有限者固然可以这样被置于流动之中；它本身就是那个被规定走向其终结者，但只是走向其终结；——毋宁说，它是拒绝向它的肯定者、即无限者肯定地靠过去、拒绝让自己与它和解；因此它被设定为与它的无不可分离，而与它的他者、即肯定者的一切和解也就因此被切断了。
有限事物的规定无非就是它们的终结。
知性固守在这种对有限性的哀痛之中，因为它把非存在变成了事物的规定，同时又使它们成为不灭的、绝对的。
它们的易逝只能在其的他者、即肯定者中消逝；那样的话，有限性就会从它们身上分离出来；但它就是它们那不变的质，即不过渡到其的他者、即不过渡到其肯定者的质；所以它是永恒的。

en: This is a very important consideration; that the finite is absolute, however, no philosophy or view or the understanding will readily be willing to take on this standpoint; rather the opposite is explicitly present in the assertion of the finite; the finite is the limited, the perishable; the finite is only the finite, not the imperishable; this lies immediately in its determination and expression.
But it depends on whether in the view one persists in the being of finitude, whether transitoriness remains, or whether transitoriness and perishing perish.
That this does not happen is precisely the fact in that view of the finite which makes perishing the last of the finite.
It is the explicit assertion that the finite is incompatible and irreconcilable with the infinite, that the finite is simply opposed to the infinite.

Being, absolute being, is ascribed to the infinite; over against it the finite is thus held fast as its negative; incompatible with the infinite, it remains absolutely on its own side; it would receive affirmation from the affirmative, the infinite, and would thus perish; but a union with the same is what is declared to be impossible.
If instead of standing over against a persisting infinite it perishes, then, as said before, its perishing is the last, not the affirmative, which would only be the perishing of the perishing.
But if the finite were not to perish in the affirmative but its end were to be taken as the nothing, then we would be back at that first, abstract nothing which has itself long since passed away.
zh: 这是一项极为重要的考察；不过，某种哲学、某种观点或知性大概都不会愿意承担「有限者是绝对的」这一立场；毋宁说，与之相反的东西明确地就在对有限者的主张之中：有限者就是那受限制的、易逝的；有限者仅仅是有限者，而不是那不灭的；这一点直接就在它的规定与表达之中。
但这要看：在这种观点中人们是坚持有限性的存在、坚持易逝依然存在，还是易逝与消逝本身也随之消逝。
而这件事并不发生，这正是那种把消逝当作有限者之最后者的有限者观点里的事实。
明确的主张乃是：有限者与无限者不容并存、不可和解，有限者干脆与无限者相对立。
存在、绝对的存在被归于无限者；在它面前，有限者于是被牢牢地保持为它的否定者；由于与无限者不可和解，它绝对地留在自己这一边；它只有从肯定者、即从无限者那里才得到肯定，也就会这样消逝；但与后者的统一，正是被宣称为不可能的东西。
如果它不是与持存着的无限者相对立，而是消逝，那么，如前所说，它的消逝就是最后者，而不是肯定者；后者只会是消逝的消逝。
但如果有限者不是在肯定者中消逝，而是把它的终结把握为无，那么我们又会回到那个最初的、抽象的无那里，而它本身早已过去了。

en: With this nothing, however, which is only to be nothing and to which at the same time an existence in thinking, representing or speaking is granted, the same contradiction occurs as was just indicated in the finite, except that there it merely occurs, whereas in finitude it is explicit.
There it appears as subjective; here it is asserted that the finite, the in-itself trivial one, stands opposed to the infinite in perpetuity, and that it is as such an in-itself trivial one.

This must be brought to consciousness; and the development of the finite shows that in it this contradiction collapses into itself, but that it really resolves it in that way: not that the finite is merely perishable and perishes, but that perishing, the nothing, is not the last, but perishes.
zh: 然而在这个无——它只应当是无，同时却又被赋予了在思维、表象或言说中的存在——那里，出现的正是刚才在有限者身上所指出过的同一个矛盾，只不过在那里它只是出现，而在有限性中则是明确的。
在那里它表现为主观的；在这里则主张：有限者——那自在地无足轻重者——永远与无限者相对立，并且作为自在地无足轻重者而存在。
这一点必须被带到意识中来；而有限者的展开表明：这一矛盾在有限者身上归结为它自身，但它是以这样的方式真正地解决这一矛盾的：并非说有限者仅仅是易逝的并且会消逝，而是说消逝、这个无，并不是最后者，而是会消逝。

8.en: β. The limit and the ought

en: This contradiction is indeed immediately present in the abstract form that the something is finite, or that the finite is.

But the something or being is no longer posited abstractly, but reflected into itself and developed as being-in-self, which has a determination and a determinate constitution in itself, and even more precisely, that it has a limit in itself, which, as what is immanent to the something and constituting the quality of its being-in-self, is finitude.
In this concept of the finite something it is to be seen what moments are contained.
zh: 这一矛盾诚然立刻就以这种抽象的方式存在于其中：某物是有限的，或者说，有限者存在。
但某物或存在不再是被抽象地设定的，而是被反思回自身并展开为自身内存在：它自身带有一种规定和一种性质；更确切地说，它自身带有一种界限，而这一界限作为内在于某物、构成其自身内存在之质的东西，就是有限性。
在这有限某物的概念中，可以看出包含着哪些环节。

en: Determination and determinate constitution turned out to be sides for external reflection; but the former already contained otherness as belonging to the being-in-itself of the something; the externality of otherness is on the one hand within the own internality of the something, on the other hand it remains as externality distinguished from it; it is still externality as such, but externality in the something.

But since further otherness is determined as limit, itself as negation of the negation, the otherness immanent to the something is posited as the relation of the two sides, and the unity of the something with itself, to which both determination and determinate constitution belong, is its relation turned back upon itself, the relation of its determinate constitution existing in itself onto its immanent limit, which negates that limit in itself.

The being-in-self identical with itself relates to itself as its own non-being, but as negation of the negation, as negating the same, which at the same time preserves determinate being in itself, for it is the quality of its being-in-self: the own limit of the something, posited by it as a negative which is at the same time essential, is not only limit as such, but limit.

But the limit is not alone what is posited as negated; the negation is two-edged, in that what is posited as negated by it is the limit; this limit, namely, is in general what the something and the other have in common, and at the same time the determinateness of the being-in-itself of the determination as such.
This being-in-itself is accordingly the negative relation to its limit, which is also distinguished from it, and to itself as limit, ought.
zh: 规定与性质显示出来是供外在反思使用的两个方面；但前者已经包含了他在，作为属于某物的自在；他者的外在性一方面就在某物自身的内在性之中，另一方面它作为外在性仍与后者相区别：它还是作为这样的外在性，但却是处在某物之中的外在性。
但既然他在进一步又被规定为界限，甚至被规定为否定之否定，那么内在于某物的他在就被设定为这两个方面的关系；而某物与自身的统一——规定与性质都归属于它——就是它那转向自身的关系，即它那自在存在的规定对其内在界限的关系，这一关系在界限中否定界限。
那与自身同一的自身内存在与自身相关，把自身当作自己的非存在，但它是作为否定之否定、作为否定着同一个东西而如此相关，而这个否定同时在自身中保有定在，因为它是其自身内存在的质：某物自身的界限被它设定为一个同时是本质性的否定者，因此不仅是作为这样的界限，而且是限度。
但限度并不单是被设定为被否定者；否定是双刃的，因为由它设定为被否定者的正是界限；而这一界限一般地就是某物与他者共有的东西，同时也是规定作为这样的自在存在的规定性。
因而这一自在存在就是对它那同样与它相区别开的界限的否定关系，是对自身作为限度、作为应然的关系。

en: That the limit in the something in general is to be a limit, it must at the same time in itself go beyond it, and relate to it in itself as to a non-self.
The determinate being of the something lies quietly, indifferently, as it were alongside its limit.
The something, however, goes beyond its limit only insofar as it is the sublation of that limit, the being-in-itself negative as against it.
And since it is in the determination itself as limit, the something thereby goes beyond itself.
zh: 某物一般地所具有的这个界限既然是限度，那么它同时就必须在自身中越过它，在自身中把它当作非自身者来相关。
某物的定在安静地、无关紧要地仿佛躺在它的界限旁边。
某物唯有在它是这一界限的扬弃、是那反对界限的否定性自在存在的范围内，才越过它的界限。
而既然界限在规定自身中就是作为界限，某物也就由此越过了自身。

en: The ought therefore contains the doubled determination: once the determination as a determination existing in itself against the negation, and then again the same as a non-being which, as limit, is distinguished from it, but at the same time is itself a determinate being-in-itself.
zh: 因此，应然包含着双重的规定：一方面是作为自在地存在着的规定而反对否定，另一方面则是同一个规定作为一个非存在——它作为界限区别于否定，但同时本身又自在地存在着的规定。

en: The finite has thus determined itself as the relation of its determination to its limit; the former is in this relation the ought, the latter is limit.
Both are thus moments of the finite, thus both are themselves finite, both the ought and the limit.
But only the limit is posited as the finite; the ought is only in itself, thus for us, limited.

Through its relation to the limit already immanent to it, it is limited, but this limitation of its is enveloped in being-in-itself, for according to its determinate being, that is, according to its determinateness against the limit, it is posited as being-in-itself.
zh: 有限者就这样把自己规定为它的规定对它的界限的关系；在这一关系中，前者是应然，后者是界限。
两者都是有限者的环节，因而两者自身也都是有限的：应然如此，界限也如此。
但只有界限才被设定为有限者；应然则仅仅自在地、因而对我们来说，是受限的。
由于它与那已经内在于它自身的界限的关系，它是受限的；但它这种限制却被包裹在自在存在之中，因为按照它的定在，即按照它对界限的规定性，它是被设定为自在存在的。

en: What is to be is and at the same time is not.
If it were, then it would not merely be.
The ought therefore essentially has a limit.
This limit is not something alien; what is merely to be is the determination, which is now posited as it is in fact, namely at the same time only a determinateness.
zh: 那应当是的东西，是，同时又不是。
如果它是，那么它就不只是是。
所以应然本质上有一道界限。
这道界限并不是外在的他物；那仅仅是应当存在的东西，就是那规定，它现在被设定为它实际上的样子，即同时只是一种规定性。

en: The being-in-itself of the something in its determination thus lowers itself to the ought in that what constitutes its being-in-itself is at one and the same time non-being; and precisely in such a way that in the being-in-self, the negation of the negation, this being-in-itself is as the one negation (the negating) united with the other, which at the same time is a qualitatively different limit, and by virtue of which that unity is a relation to it.

The limit of the finite is not something external, but its own determination is also its limit; and this is both the limit itself and the ought; it is what the two have in common or rather that in which the two are identical.
zh: 某物在其规定中的自在存在因此降格为应然，因为构成其自在存在的那个东西，在同一个考量之下就是非存在；并且正是这样：在自身内存在——即否定之否定——之中，那自在存在作为一个否定（那否定着的东西）与另一个否定相统一，而这个否定同时又是一个质上不同的界限；正是由于这一界限，那统一才成为对它的关系。
有限者的界限并不是外在的东西，而是它自己的规定同时也是它的界限；而这一界限既是界限自身，也是应然；它是二者的共同者，或者毋宁说，是二者同一之处。

en: As the ought, however, the finite now further goes beyond its limit: the very determinateness which is its negation is at the same time sublated and is thus its being-in-itself; its limit is also not its limit.
zh: 作为应然，有限者现在进一步越过它的界限：那个构成其否定的规定性同时也被扬弃了，因此就是它的自在存在；它的界限也就不再是它的界限。

en: As the ought, thus, the something is elevated above its limit; conversely, however, it has its limit only as the ought.
Both are inseparable.
The something has a limit insofar as it has the negation in its determination, and the determination is at the same time the sublation of the limit.
zh: 作为应然，某物被提升到它的界限之上；但反过来，它只有作为应然才具有它的界限。
两者不可分离。
某物之所以具有一道界限，就在于它在其规定中具有否定；而规定同时也就是界限的扬弃。

en: The ought has of late played a great role in philosophy, especially in relation to morality, and metaphysically in general it has also served as the last and absolute concept of the identity of being-in-itself or of the relation to itself and of determinateness or of the limit.
zh: 应然近来在哲学中扮演了重大角色，尤其是在与道德的关系上；在形而上学中，它一般地也曾充当自在存在的同一性、或与自身的关系以及规定性或界限的最后而绝对的概念。

en: You can because you ought – this expression, which should say a great deal, lies in the concept of the ought.
For the ought is the going-forth beyond the limit; the limit is sublated in it, the being-in-itself of the ought is thus an identical relation to itself, hence the abstraction of being able.
– But conversely it is just as true: you cannot, precisely because you ought.

For in the ought there lies just as much the limit as limit; that formalism of possibility has in it a reality, a qualitative otherness over against it, and the relation of the two to each other is the contradiction, hence the not-being-able or rather the impossibility.
zh: 你能够，因为你应当——这个本应说出许多的表述，就蕴含在应然的概念之中。
因为应然就是越出界限；界限在它之中被扬弃，应然的自在存在因此就是那与自身的同一关系，从而就是「能够」的抽象。
——但反过来同样正确：你不能，正因为你应当。
因为在应然之中同样有着作为界限的界限；那种可能性的形式主义在它身上面对着一种实在性、一种质上的他在，而两者彼此的关系就是矛盾，从而就是「不能」或毋宁说是不可能性。

en: In the ought the going-forth beyond finitude, the infinity, begins.
The ought is that which, in further development after that impossibility, presents itself as the progress into infinity.
zh: 在应然之中，对有限性的越出、无限性，开始了。
应然就是那个在经过那种不可能性之后的进一步发展中表现为向无限性的进展者。

en: With respect to the form of the limit and of the ought, two prejudices can be more closely reproached.
One traditionally holds fast above all to the limits of thinking, of reason etc., and it is asserted that one cannot go beyond the limit.
In this assertion lies the unconsciousness that in it itself, in the fact that something is determined as limit, one has already gone beyond it.
For a determinateness, a limit, is determined as limit only in contrast with its other in general, with its unlimited: the other of a limit is precisely the going-out beyond it.
The stone, the metal, is not beyond its limit, precisely because for it it is not a limit.

If, however, with such general propositions of sober thinking, that one cannot go beyond the limit, thinking does not want to apply itself in order to see what lies in the concept, one can appeal to actuality, where such propositions indeed show themselves to be the most unreal.

Precisely by virtue of the fact that thinking is to be something higher than actuality, is to keep itself away from it in higher regions, that is, is itself determined as an ought, on the one hand it does not proceed to the concept, and on the other hand it happens to it that it relates itself just as untruly to actuality as to the concept.
– Because the stone does not think, does not even feel, its limitedness is for it no limit, that is, in it there is not a negation for feeling, representation, thinking etc., which it does not have.

But the stone itself too is as something distinguished into its determination or its being-in-itself and its determinate being, and insofar as this is so it too goes beyond its limit; the concept which it is in itself contains the identity with its other.
If it is a base that acids can act upon, then it is oxidizable, neutralizable etc.

In the oxidation, neutralization etc., its limit, that of being there merely as base, is sublated; it goes beyond it, just as the acid sublates its limit of being acid, and in it as in the caustic base the ought to go beyond their limit is so present that they can only be held fast as – anhydrous, that is, purely non-neutral – acid and caustic base by force.
zh: 就界限与应然的形式而言，可以更切近地指摘两种偏见。
人们习惯于首先紧紧抓住思维、理性等等的界限，并主张说不能越过界限。
在这一主张中含着一种不自觉：因为就在其中，就在某物被规定为界限这件事本身，人们就已经越过了界限。
因为一种规定性、一种界限，只有在与它的他者一般、即与它的无界限者相对立时，才被规定为界限：界限的他者恰恰就是越出它。
石头、金属并不越过它的界限，正因为对它来说那并不是界限。
然而，如果对于这类出于清醒思维的一般命题——即不能越过界限——思维不愿挺身去看概念中包含着什么，那么人们就可以诉诸现实性，在那里这类命题恰恰显出是最不现实的东西。
恰恰由于思维被规定为应当是某种高于现实性的东西、应当在更高的领域里远离现实性，也就是说思维自身被规定为一个应然，它一方面就不能前进到概念，另一方面它就发生了这样的情形：它对现实性的关系和对概念的关系同样是不真的。
——因为石头不思维，甚至不感觉，所以它的受限性对它来说并不是界限，即在它之中并没有一种为感觉、表象、思维等等而设的否定——这些它并不具有。
不过，石头本身作为某物也被区别为它的规定、它的自在存在与它的定在；就此而言，它也越过了它的界限；它自在地是的那一概念，包含着与他者的同一性。
如果它是一种能被酸作用的碱基，那么它就是可氧化的、可中和的等等。
在氧化、中和等等之中，它那「仅仅是作为碱基而在」的界限被扬弃了；它越过了这一界限，正如酸扬弃了它那「作为酸而在」的界限一样；而且在它里面、就像在苛性碱基里面一样，越过自己界限的应然是如此地存在，以至于它们只有靠强力才能被保持为——无水的，即纯粹非中性的——酸与苛性碱基。

en: But if an existence contains the concept not merely as abstract being-in-itself but as totality existing for itself, as drive, as life, feeling, representation etc., then it itself accomplishes from it this: to be beyond the limit and to go out beyond it.
The plant goes beyond the limit of being a germ, equally beyond the limit of being blossom, fruit, leaf; the germ becomes the unfolded plant, the blossom fades etc.
The feeling being within the limit of hunger, thirst etc. is the drive to go beyond this limit, and accomplishes this going-beyond.

It feels pain, and the prerogative of feeling nature is to feel pain; there is a negation in its self, and this is determined in its feeling as a limit, precisely because the feeling being has the feeling of its self, which is the totality that is beyond that determinateness.
If it were not beyond it, it would not feel the same as its negation and would have no pain.

– But reason, thinking, should not be able to go beyond the limit, – it, which is the universal which is for itself beyond the limit, that is, beyond all particularity, is nothing but the going-beyond the limit.

– Of course, not every going-beyond and being-out beyond the limit is a true liberation from it, a true affirmation; the ought itself is already such an imperfect going-beyond and abstraction in general.

But the pointing to the wholly abstract universal is enough against the equally abstract assurance that one cannot go beyond the limit, or already the pointing to the infinite in general against the assurance that one cannot go beyond the finite.
zh: 但如果一种存在并不只是把概念作为抽象的自在存在包含着，而是作为自为存在的总体性、作为冲动、作为生命、感受、表象等等包含着，那么它自己就从这概念中完成这一点：存在于界限之外并越出界限。
植物越过了「作为胚芽而在」的界限，同样越过了「作为花、作为果实、作为叶而在」的界限；胚芽成为展开的植物，花凋谢，等等。
处在饥饿、口渴等等的界限之中的感受者，就是那越过这一界限的冲动，并完成这种越出。
它感受痛苦，而感受着的自然的特权就是感受痛苦；在它自身之中有一种否定，而这一否定在它的感受中被规定为一道界限，正是因为感受者具有对自身的感受，而这一感受就是那个超出那一规定性的总体性。
如果它不是越过了界限，它就不会把那同一个否定感受为自己的否定，也就不会有痛苦。
——但理性、思维不应当能够越过界限，——它，那普遍者，那本身即超出界限、亦即超出一切特殊性的东西，无非就是越出界限这一件事。
——当然，并非每一种越过界限、在界限之外的存在都是对界限的真正解放、真正的肯定；应然本身就已经是这样一种不完善的越出，是抽象一般。
但以那完全抽象的普遍者来反驳同样抽象的保证——即不能越过界限——已经足够了；或者，以无限者一般来反驳那不能越过有限者的保证，也就足够了。

en: Here one may mention a Leibnizian thought which seems to the point: if a magnet had consciousness, it would take its direction toward the north for a determination of its will, a law of its freedom.

Rather, if it had consciousness, and with it will and freedom, it would be thinking; the space would thus be for it a general space containing all directions, and so the one direction toward the north would rather be a limit for its freedom, just as for man it is a limit to be held fast in one place, whereas for the plant it is not.
zh: 在这里可以提一下莱布尼茨一个看起来很到点子的想法：如果磁石有意识，它就会把自己朝北的方向看作自己意志的一种规定、自己自由的一条法则。
毋宁说，如果它有意识，因而有意志与自由，它就会是能思维的了；这样，空间对它来说就是那个包含一切方向的普遍空间，因此那一个朝北的方向毋宁说是它自由的一道界限，正如对人类来说，被固定在一处是一道界限，而对植物来说却不是。

en: The ought, on the other hand, is the going-beyond the limit, but a going-beyond which is itself only finite.
It therefore has its place and its validity in the field of finitude, where it holds fast being-in-itself against the limited and asserts it as the rule and the essential against the trivial.

Duty is an ought turned against the particular will, against the selfish desire and the wilful interest; to the will, insofar as it can isolate itself in its mobility from the true, this is held up as an ought.

Those who hold the ought of morality so high and think in it that morality would be destroyed if the ought were not acknowledged as the last and the true, as well as the rationalists whose understanding gives itself the constant satisfaction of being able to bring forward against everything that exists an ought and thus a knowing-better, and who do not want to have the ought snatched from them, do not see that for the finitude of their circles the ought is completely acknowledged.

– But in actuality itself the situation with rationality and law is not so bad that they should merely be – with only the abstraction of being-in-itself remaining [in view] –, any more than it is that the ought should be perpetual in itself and, what is the same, the finitude absolute.

The Kantian and Fichtean philosophy gives the ought as the highest point of the resolution of the contradictions of reason, which is however much more only the standpoint of persistence in finitude and thereby in contradiction.
zh: 另一方面，应然就是越出界限，但只是一个本身仍属有限的越出。
因此它在场于有限性的领域之中并在那里有效：在那里它坚持自在存在以对抗那受限制者，并把自在存在主张为那与无足轻重者相对立的规则和本质者。
义务是转向特殊意志、转向自私的欲望与任性的利害关系的一个应然；意志就其能在活动性中把自己与真实者隔离开而言，这一个应然就被提在它面前。
那些如此看重道德学说的应然、并以为一旦应然不被承认为最后者与真实者，道德就会遭到破坏的人，以及那些理性主义者——他们的知性不断以能够针对一切存在之物提出一个应然、因而提出一种更高明的见识来满足自己——那些不愿让人把应然从他们手里夺走的人，都没有看到：对于他们那些圈子的有限性来说，应然是完全被承认的。
——但在现实性本身之中，理性与法则的处境并没有糟糕到它们仅仅是「应当如此」的地步——在这一说法中只留下自在存在的抽象物——；同样也不是说应然在它自身之中是持存不灭的、而这也就等于说有限性是绝对的。
康德哲学与费希特哲学把应然当作理性之矛盾的化解的最高点，但这毋宁说只是固守在有限性、因而固守在矛盾之中的立场。

26.en: γ. The transition of the finite into the infinite
26.zh: γ. 有限者向无限者的过渡

en: The ought in itself contains the limit, and the limit the ought.
Their relation to one another is the finite itself, which contains both of them in its being-in-self.
These moments of its determination are qualitatively opposed to each other; the limit is determined as the negative of the ought and the ought likewise as the negative of the limit.
The finite is thus the contradiction in itself; it sublates itself, perishes.
But this its result, the negative in general, is 1. its determination itself; for it is the negative of the negative.

Thus the finite has not perished in the perishing; it has first only become another finite, which however is just as much the perishing as a passing-over into another finite, and so on, roughly into infinity.
But 2. considering this result more closely, the finite has in its perishing, this negation of itself, attained its being-in-itself; it has therein come together with itself.
Each of its moments contains precisely this result; the ought goes beyond the limit, that is, beyond itself; but beyond it or its other is only the limit itself.

The limit, however, points immediately beyond itself to its other, which is the ought; this, however, is the same splitting of being-in-itself and determinate being as the limit, is the same; hence it too goes beyond itself only by coming together with itself.
This identity with itself, the negation of the negation, is affirmative being, thus the other of the finite, as which the first negation is to have its determinateness; – that other is the infinite.
zh: 自在的应然包含着界限，而界限包含着应然。
它们彼此的关系就是有限者本身，它在自身内存在中包含着两者。
它的这些规定环节在质上彼此对立；界限被规定为应然的否定，而应然同样被规定为界限的否定。
有限者于是就是它自身的矛盾；它扬弃自身、消逝。
但它的这一结果——否定一般——1. 正是它自己的规定；因为它是否定的否定。
因此，有限者并没有在消逝中消逝；它起初只是变成了另一个有限者，而这个有限者同样既是消逝，又是过渡到另一个有限者，如此等等，大致一直到无限者。
但 2. 更仔细地考察这一结果，有限者在其消逝、这一对自身的否定之中达到了它的自在存在；它在其中与自身合一。
它的每一个环节恰恰都包含着这一结果；应然越过界限，即越过自身；但在它之外或它的他者只是界限自身。
但界限则直接指向自身之外的他者，而那他者就是应然；但应然是与界限同样的自在存在与定在的分裂，是同一个东西；因此它同样只有通过与自身合一才越出自身。
这种与自身的同一性、否定之否定，是肯定的存在，因而是有限者的他者，因为第一否定正应当以此作为自己的规定性；——那个他者就是无限者。

en: The infinite in its simple concept can at first be looked upon as a new definition of the absolute; it is posited as the relation-to-self without any determination as being and becoming.

The forms of determinate being fall away from the series of the determinations which can be regarded as definitions of the absolute, since the forms of that sphere are for themselves immediately posited only as determinatenesses, as finite in general.

The infinite, however, counts simply as absolute, since it is expressly determined as the negation of the finite, and thereby the restrictedness of being and becoming – even if they have or show no restrictedness in themselves, yet are perhaps capable of it – is expressly taken into account in the infinite and such a restrictedness is negated in it.
zh: 无限者在其单纯的概念中，起初可以被看作绝对者的一种新定义；它被设定为那种无规定地与自身相关的存在与生成。
定在的各种形式从那些可以被视为绝对者定义的规定序列中消失了，因为那个领域的诸形式就其自身而言直接地只被设定为诸规定性、设定为有限者一般。
然而无限者干脆被看作绝对的，因为它被明确规定为有限者的否定；因而存在与生成所具有的那种受限性——即便它们在自身中并没有或显示出受限性，却毕竟是可能有的——在无限者中被明确地顾及到，并在它里面被否定。

en: But with that the infinite itself is not yet in fact released from restrictedness and finitude; the main thing is to distinguish the true concept of infinity from bad infinity, the infinite of reason from the infinite of the understanding; yet the latter is the finitized infinite, and it will appear that precisely by keeping the infinite purely and entirely apart from the finite, it is only finitized.
The infinite is
zh: 但以此，无限者本身在事实上还没有从受限性与有限性中脱身出来；主要的事情是把无限性的真正概念与坏的无限性、理性的无限者与知性的无限者区分开来；但后者就是被有限化了的无限者，而且将会表明：恰恰由于人们要把无限者纯粹而完全地与有限者分开，它才只是被有限化了。
无限者是

en: a) in simple determination the affirmative as negation of the finite;
zh: a) 在单纯的规定中，是作为有限者之否定的肯定者；

en: b) but it is thereby in reciprocal determination with the finite and is the abstract, one-sided infinite;
zh: b) 但它由此与有限者处于相互规定之中，并且是那个抽象的、片面的无限者；

en: c) the self-sublation of this infinite as of the finite as a process – is the true infinite.
zh: c) 这一无限者以及有限者的自我扬弃，作为一个过程——才是真正的无限者。

en: The infinite is the negation of the negation, the affirmative, the being which has restored itself from restrictedness.
The infinite is, and in a more intensive sense than the first immediate being; it is the true being, the elevation from out of the limit.

At the name of the infinite the heart and the spirit are enlightened, for in it they are not only abstractly with themselves but elevate themselves to themselves, to the light of their thinking, of their universality, of their freedom.
zh: 无限者是否定的否定，是肯定者，是那从受限性中重新恢复过来的存在。
无限者是，而且是在比第一个直接存在更强烈的意义上；它是真正的存在，是从界限中提升出来。
在无限者这个名字上，内心与精神都亮了起来，因为无限者在其中并非仅仅抽象地与自身同在，而是把自己提升到自身，提升到它自己的思维、普遍性与自由的光亮之中。

en: First it has resulted for the concept of the infinite that determinate being in its being-in-itself determines itself as finite and goes beyond the limit.
It is the nature of the finite itself to go beyond itself, to negate its negation and to become infinite.
The infinite thus does not stand over the finite as something finished in itself, so that the finite would have and keep its being outside of or under that.
So far we still go beyond the finite into the infinite only as a subjective reason.

When one says that the infinite is the concept of reason and that we raise ourselves through reason above the temporal, one lets this happen entirely without prejudice to the finite, which that elevation remaining external to it does not concern.

Insofar, however, the finite itself is raised into infinity, it is just as little a foreign power that does this to it; rather it is its nature to relate itself to itself as limit, both as limit as such and as ought, and to go beyond it, or rather to have negated it as relation-to-self and to be beyond it.
Infinity in general does not come about through the sublation of finitude in general; rather the finite is only this, to become such through its nature itself.
Infinity is its affirmative determination, that which it truly is in itself.
zh: 首先，就无限者的概念而言已经得出：定在在其自在存在中把自己规定为有限者，并越过界限。
越过自身、否定自己的否定并成为无限的，正是有限者自身的本性。
因此无限者并不是作为一个自为的完成者凌驾于有限者之上，以致有限者必须在它之外或之下保持其存在。
目前我们还只是作为一个主观的理性越过有限者而进入无限者。
当人们说无限者是理性的概念、我们通过理性把自己提升到时间性的事物之上时，人们就任这件事发生而完全不管有限者，因为那种始终留在它之外的提升与它无关。
但就有限者自身被提升到无限性而言，这同样不是一种外在的强力对它做这件事；毋宁说，这就是它的本性：把自己与自身相关联为界限、既作为作为这样的界限也作为应然，并越过它；或者毋宁说，作为与自身的关系已经把它否定掉，并存在于它之外。
无限性一般并不是通过对有限性一般本身的扬弃而产生的；毋宁说，有限者只是这个：通过它自己的本性而成为无限者。
无限性是它的肯定的规定，是它自在地真正是的东西。

en: Thus the finite has vanished in the infinite, and what is, is only the infinite.
zh: 于是有限者在无限者中消失了，而所存在的只有无限者。

38.en: b. Reciprocal determination of the finite and the infinite
38.zh: b. 有限者与无限者的相互规定

en: The infinite is; in this immediacy it is at the same time the negation of an other, of the finite.

Thus being as something and at the same time as the non-being of an other, it has fallen back into the category of the something as of a determinate in general, more precisely – because it is the determinate being reflected into itself which has resulted through the sublation of determinateness in general, and thereby posited as the determinate being distinguished from its determinateness – into the category of the something with a limit.

According to this determinateness the finite stands over against the infinite as real determinate being; thus they stand in qualitative relation as remaining outside one another; the immediate being of the infinite revives the being of its negation, of the finite, which had at first seemed to vanish in the infinite.
zh: 无限者是；在这一直接性中它同时是另一个者、即有限者的否定。
这样，既作为存在者又同时作为另一个者的非存在，它就退回到了「作为某个被规定者一般的某物」这一范畴——更确切地说，因为它是在自身中反思着的、通过一般地扬弃规定性而得出的定在，因而被设定为与其规定性相区别开的定在——退回到了「带有一个界限的某物」这一范畴。
按照这一规定性，有限者作为实在的定在与无限者相对立；这样，两者以质的关系彼此外在；无限者的直接存在重新唤起了其否定、即有限者的存在，而有限者起初似乎已在无限者中消失了。

en: But the infinite and the finite are not only in these categories of relation; the two sides are further determined than merely to be others opposed to one another.
Finitude, namely, is the limit posited as limit; it is determinate being posited with the determination of passing over into its being-in-itself, of becoming infinite.

Infinity is the nothing of the finite, of its being-in-itself and ought, but this nothing at the same time as reflected into itself, the executed ought, the being that relates only to itself, entirely affirmative being.
In infinity there is present the satisfaction that all determinateness, all change, all limit and with it the ought itself has vanished, has been sublated, that the nothing of the finite is posited.
As this negation of the finite, being-in-itself is determined, which is so affirmative in itself as negation of the negation.

This affirmation, however, is as qualitatively immediate a relation to itself, being; through this the infinite is reduced back to the category that it has the finite as an other over against it; its negative nature is posited as the existing, hence first and immediate negation.

The infinite is in this way afflicted with the opposition against the finite, which, as an other, at the same time remains the determinate, real determinate being, even though it is at the same time posited as sublated in its being-in-itself, in the infinite; this is the non-finite, – a being in the determinateness of negation.

Against the finite, the circle of existing determinatenesses, of realities, the infinite is the indeterminate emptiness, the beyond of the finite, which does not have its being-in-itself at its determinate being, which is a determinate one.
zh: 但无限者与有限者并不仅仅处在这些关系的范畴中；这两个方面还有比仅仅互为他者更进一步的規定。
因为有限性就是那被设定为界限的界限；它就是那带着过渡到自身自在存在、成为无限者的规定而被设定起来的定在。
无限性是有限者的无，是其自在存在与应然的无，但这个无同时也是那在自身中反思着的、被执行了的应然，是那仅仅与自身相关的、全然肯定的存在。
在无限性中有着这样一种满足：一切规定性、一切变化、一切界限以及与界限一道的应然本身，都消失了、都被扬弃了，有限者的无被设定起来了。
作为有限者的这一否定，自在存在被规定为：它作为否定之否定，在自身中是肯定性的。
然而这一肯定作为质的直接自身关系、作为存在；由此无限者被还原到这样一个范畴：它把有限者作为一个他者面对着自己；它的否定性的本性被设定为那存在着的、因而是第一个而直接的否定。
无限者就是这样带上了与有限者的对立；有限者作为他者同时仍然是那规定的、实在的定在，虽然它在自在存在、即在无限者之中同时被设定为被扬弃了；这个（有限者）是非有限者——是处在否定之规定性中的存在。
与有限者、那存在着的规定性、那实在性的圆圈相对，无限者就是那不确定的虚无，就是有限者的彼岸；它的自在存在并不在它的定在（一个被规定了的定在）之中。

en: So, with the infinite set against the finite in the qualitative relation of others to one another, it is to be called the bad infinite, the infinite of the understanding, for which it counts as the highest, as the absolute truth; to bring him to consciousness of the fact that in thinking himself to have attained his satisfaction in the reconciliation of truth, he finds himself in the unreconciled, unresolved, absolute contradiction – the contradictions would have to be brought about into which he falls on all sides as soon as he undertakes the application and explication of these his categories.
zh: 这样，当无限者与有限者在彼此作为他者的质关系中被设定起来时，它就该叫做坏的无限者、知性的无限者；对它来说，它被当作最高的、当作绝对的真理；若要使它意识到：它在自以为于真理的和解中达到了满足时，其实处在那个未和解、未消解的绝对矛盾之中——那么，随着它开始运用并说明这些范畴，它就会在各个方向上陷入的那些矛盾就必须被造成。
